component.name: Ludot Engine
component.summary: Multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine with a feature-rich editor

description.p: Ludot is a desktop game engine for 2D and 3D projects, with native Luau, GDScript, and Luau shaders.
This is an independent hard fork of Godot and Luau. Original engine and dependency licenses remain in the source distribution.
